stories.title: Thursday brings an uptick in temps but rain and snow continue to roll through
stories.summary: The daily forecast from Idaho's trusted KTVB First Alert Weather team.

stories.title: Ada County Sheriff's Office warns public about jail bond scams
stories.summary: Authorities said scammers are targeting the loved ones of recently incarcerated people by posing as bondsmen or sheriff's office representatives.

stories.title: 7Cares Idaho Shares 2026: Here's how to help
stories.summary: 7Cares Idaho Shares has provided over 15 million meals to Idahoans since 2008. The annual donation drive begins Nov. 27 and continues through 7Cares Day on Dec. 12.

stories.title: Prescribed burns scheduled through March in southwest Idaho
stories.summary: The Bureau of Land Management plans prescribed burns on southwest Idaho public lands to reduce wildfire risk, starting in December.

stories.title: Idaho's low vaccination rates raise concerns as measles cases climb nationwide
stories.summary: “We've been lucky in Idaho to not have a mass spreading event," one medical expert said.

stories.title: Game Day Guide: No. 17 Boise State battles San Diego State on The Blue
stories.summary: Boise State aims to extend its winning streak to ten as it hosts San Diego State on Senior Night with a spot in the Pac-12 championship already secured.

stories.title: Meridian Fanci Freez closes after seven years of tasty treats
stories.summary: "We are incredibly grateful for the memories, support, and smiling faces that made our time in Meridian so special," Fanci Freez posted to Instagram.

stories.title: One final ride: Revolution Concert House closing Garden City venue after 14 years, new venue on deck
stories.summary: The Revolution Concert House's planned move will bring the hall to Meridian, under the project name of "Revolution 2."

stories.title: Idaho Fish and Game commissioner steps down after entering guilty plea for poaching charges
stories.summary: Originally charged with seven misdemeanor counts, Brody Harshbarger agreed to enter a guilty plea. He has stepped down from IDFG leadership.

stories.title: Friday Night Football: Find Idaho high school state championship matchups
stories.summary: As the Idaho high school football season culminates, unexpected matchups in state championships beckon, with multiple southern Idaho schools poised to seize glory.

stories.title: ACHD opens up sale process for former headquarters
stories.summary: The organization said it received no sealed bids, and will move forward with offers from prospective buyers interested in the Adams Street property.

stories.title: Twin Falls announces month-long traffic restrictions on Market Street
stories.summary: Drivers in Twin Falls should prepare for traffic impacts beginning Nov. 18 as construction gets underway on Market Street between Blake Street and Russet Street.
